notes.title: A Sneak Peek at ATONE Combat and Music
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/38993a11746e685279592e53ebfab7d29aaa5bb9.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Midgardians![/h1]

[b]ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree[/b], the upcoming title from our friends at [b]Untold Tales[/b] and [b]Wildboy Studios[/b], launches in just 10 short days, so we wanted to provide a nice snippet of combat and a preview of the incredible soundtrack that awaits you. 

[h2]FIGHT TO THE BEAT[/h2]

Combat is all about surviving to the end of the song. Let's have a quick look at a battle against the Ice King in Hard Mode.

[previewyoutube=rv55TIzzBgs;full][/previewyoutube]

Keep focused and stick to the rhythm and you'll land a strike. But make too many mistakes and it'll cost you! 

If you find yourself struggling or unable to vanquish your enemies, there's always Normal Moe which makes the notes appear on 2 rails only. There is also Story Mode, where combat is entirely winnable, every time, allowing you to focus on the incredible narrative.

All fights can then be replayed in the Arena Mode for those wanting that perfect score or certain trophies.

[h2]A TASTE OF THE TUNES[/h2]

We've also got a little sneak peak at the amazing in-game OST, composed by the talented [b]James Shuar[/b] also know in the electronica scene as [b]Luminist[/b], as well as contributions from composer Andrew Prahlow ([b]The Outer Wilds[/b]). 

Have a listen to "Sons of Fenrir" and transport yourself to the wilds of ATONE.

[previewyoutube=ls_CZHd7p_M;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for reading!

♥️ It would be very helpful if you follow and wishlist the game below ♥️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620/ATONE_Heart_of_the_Elder_Tree/

notes.title: Welcoming Three New Titles to Untold Tales!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/23e3d546cdfad2dc822f6efc50a954a42856a0a5.png[/img]

Our collection of story-loving games continues to grow. We are excited to share that we've added three additional titles to the Untold Tales portfolio with Mythic Ocean, Lifeslide, and Dr Livingstone, I Presume?!

https://youtu.be/dYh9dC0CAJ4

If you could decide the evolutionary fate of the entire ocean, what choices would you make? Mythic Ocean is a narrative exploration about meeting the gods who rule beneath the waves and guiding (or misguiding) them in their choices.  An engaging choice driven game with multiple outcomes, an open-world feel and relaxed pace. Every interaction you make with a character changes the course of the world and story and the , so choose wisely. Or entertainingly. In fact, try both, since this story has tons of replayability.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/814360

In Dr Livingstone, I Presume? A Reversed Escape Room, the world-renowned 19th Century explorer Dr David Livingston has sent you - his most trusted friend - a cryptic message. Something is wrong but the details are scare. It’s now up to you to venture to his mysterious and eccentric mansion to uncover the truth of what has happened. Solve a mix of intricate and diverse puzzles as you venture deeper and deeper into the rooms of the mansion. Along the way, uncover historical facts and story built around real events and people but with a few creative twists.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1237510

Lifeslide is a relaxing but also challenging adventure about guiding your paper airplane through a wonderous world of sights and obstacles. Simple controls but intricate physics mean you’ll need to master the art of gathering and preserve your momentum, using the terrain to your advantage and reacting in time. All around you in the world is the story of life, and the journey we all take through it.  Additional competitive and zen modes mean there is a way for everyone.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/956140

Wishlisting and following these really helps us and the developers out!

Be sure to drop us a comment below if you've played any of the titles listed above.

---
Team Untold Tales

notes.title: Guitar Hero meets Life is Strange? You've got it.
notes.notes:
Hello folks!

We've got a story to share with you.

Our friends from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Hyperstrange]Hyperstrange[/url] are releasing a passion project of theirs. It’s called LOUD and it’s a wholesome, rhythm guitar arcade game fuelled by early 2000's inspired pop-punk / emo riffs and a classic coming-of-age story.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/0184399ccd36693b1cd115dbf5df8fb0ca7d1c74.png[/img]

The team is releasing it first on Nintendo Switch, and just a tad later here on Steam.

Here’s the launch trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=62O7Xy0ir_Y&ab_

These days, there aren’t a lot of new rhythm guitar games out there, let alone one with a story so they figured they would try fill this little gap. All the songs are custom written by them, and the story takes you on a journey of 16 year old Astrid as she goes from playing air guitar in her bedroom to signing her first deal with a talent scout. 

It’s like a mix of Guitar Hero meets Life is Strange.

If this sounds like your kind of jam, check it out on the [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/loud-switch/]Nintendo eShop[/url].

Or wishlist and follow the Steam page so you’ll find out when the game will launch on PC!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1838290/

Thanks and hope to see you right there on the stage!

notes.title: Why wishlists are very important for us
notes.notes:
Indie-loving Twitter users will know that each week indie devs everywhere hop on the #WishlistWednesday train, sharing links to their game's Steam page. The trend is always popular because, as you probably already know, wishlisting a game on Steam helps the developers, but do you know how? 

Let's take a look, shall we? What exactly does hitting that beautiful green button do for both the devs and the players?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41776195/6b7be4ca85491430453573351bc88d942f994763.png[/img]

[u][b]For the Players[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]  Once you have hit the button, Steam will keep you in the loop about the game. Any events or announcements will show at the top of your library under the What's New heading.
[*] You will be alerted when the game launches so you don't have to try to remember release dates. 
[*] Once the game has launched you will be alerted whenever it goes into a sale, and who doesn't love a bargain, hey? 
[/list]
[u][b]For the Developers
[/b][/u] [list]
[*] The wishlist function provides useful data on a game's player base, pre-launch.  Valve's Tom Giardino spoke with GamesIndustry.Biz's Marie Dealessandri back in May 2020 and talked about how "Looking at that data can indicate how much pent-up demand there is for a game, shed light on the value of a marketing effort, measure the impact of a price change, or help make future product decisions.".
[*] It helps developers estimate how well the game will sell.
[*] The more wishlists a game has the more Steam will show your game to new players in places like Top Wishlists, the Discovery Queues, and more. It is generally thought that if you hit 10k+ wishlists then Steam will put your game in the Popular Upcoming section, right on the store's front page, during your launch week!  However, there are other factors that affect this. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41776195/5f6149f77f91936c5cc30879c5d9fce6a0ec5684.gif[/img]

[u][b]Help Us Out[/b][/u]
This is by no means a full and exhaustive list, but at least you can see the impact that gorgeous green button can have.  

So with all this in mind, we have noticed that this Prologue page is getting more traffic than the full game's, and we wanted to ask that if you enjoyed your time in the multiverse, could you please head over to the full [i]What Lies in the Multiverse[/i] store page and smash that wishlist button?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1721170/What_Lies_in_the_Multiverse/

Thank you for your support. This community is awesome! 

If you want to know more about wishlists check out the Marie Dealessandri [url=https://bit.ly/GIBwishlist]article [/url].
